description: This file defines the UriInterface, an interface representing a URI object according to RFC 3986, with methods to access and modify URI components. It is essential in HTTP messaging contexts.

classes.name: UriInterface
classes.description: An interface defining methods for retrieving and modifying URI components as per RFC 3986, used in HTTP message processing.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Retrieves the URI scheme component, normalized to lowercase, or empty string if none.

methods.name: getAuthority
methods.description: Retrieves the authority component in '[user-info@]host[:port]' format.

methods.name: getUserInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the user information part, including username and optional password, or empty string if none.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Retrieves the host component, normalized to lowercase.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Retrieves the port as an integer if non-standard, or null otherwise.

methods.name: withScheme
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified URI scheme.

methods.name: withUserInfo
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified user information.

methods.name: withHost
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified host.

methods.name: withPort
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified port.

methods.name: withPath
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified path.

methods.name: withQuery
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified query string.

methods.name: withFragment
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified URI fragment.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the URI as per RFC 3986 section 4.1.
